content.comment_body: Hello, glad to be part of this forum. 1) I'm interested in building a compact SCADA system using a customizable web server. My goal is to keep the HTML5 page open without the session timing out, or at least extend the session duration as much as possible. What configuration is needed for the HTML5 page in the [product_name] web server to achieve this? 2) Is it possible to add an alarm sound on the HTML5 page created with [product_name], so that audio plays when an analog value surpasses a set threshold? Thank you very much.

Addressing your questions: Both requested features cannot be realized with the default functions available in the [product_name]. You will need to learn and apply your own HTML5 programming to achieve this.

Hello, There is a method to embed username and password directly in the URL. Usually, when you open the webpage in a browser, a login screen appears. By formatting your link as follows: https://username:password@[company_name]_IP_address you can bypass the login step. However, keep in mind that sharing this link allows others to see the credentials in plaintext. Hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to build a small-scale SCADA system with a customized web server interface, aiming to keep the web session active and add alarm sounds for analog values exceeding certain limits in the HTML5 page. Other contributors mention that these features are not available with the current [product_name], indicating a lack of native support for persistent sessions and audio alarms. This results in user dissatisfaction, as such functionality is commonly found in more advanced SCADA platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to configure the [product_name] so that the HTML5 web interface remains continuously accessible without session interruptions and to implement audio alarms triggered by analog value thresholds using built-in features.
